name: Volumetric Path Tracing with BSSRDF and Medium Sampling
aliases: Path Tracing with Subsurface Scattering and Participating Media
Subsurface Scattering Integration in Volumetric Path Tracing
summary: This method extends volumetric path tracing to handle participating media coupled with subsurface scattering by explicitly sampling BSSRDF probe segments to find exit points on the same material.
